$comment: Sign in with ChatGPT (plan usage) as driven from the phone. The browser step runs on the computer; the phone starts it, shows the wait and the outcome. `polls` maps the computer's poll answer (the engine's agent-login shape: status pending, done or error, plus `planUsage` once done and a `message` on an error) to the screen the phone shows, `actions` says what the one main button does on each screen. The computer says a declined approval in `declinedMessage`; any other error is a failed sign-in. An account that cannot use plan usage is only found when a request runs, not at sign-in, so it is not a screen here.

polls.name: a stray plan flag while pending is ignored
signed in with plan usage granted
signed in, plan usage not reported: not counted as granted
the approval was declined on the computer
the computer reports an error
polls.message: ChatGPT sign-in failed: the approval expired; try again

polls.name: a status this app does not know

plan.$comment: Which sessions run on the ChatGPT plan (the model id carries the provider: chatgpt/<slug>), and which error is the plan's usage limit (HTTP 429, code subscription_sharing_usage_limit_exceeded, or the usage settings link in the message).

limits.message: Usage limit reached. Manage usage at https://chatgpt.com/settings/usage
